description: Split a tmux pane horizontally or vertically. 'horizontal' = left/right panes side by side. 'vertical' = top/bottom panes stacked. Target format: 'session:window.pane' or 'session:window'.

command.description: Shell command to run in the new pane. WARNING: executes in your shell.

cwd.description: Working directory for the new pane.

size.description: Size of the new pane as a percentage (e.g. 50).

target.description: Target pane or window to split: 'session:window.pane'

name: split_pane
